tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background. Body text is `foreground`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Main text, amounts and headings on `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, list containers, sheets, the bottom nav and sidebar.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, toasts.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main buttons, the + in the bottom bar, the selected tab and active nav item.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet surfaces: skeletons, the Transfer row background, archived rows.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, labels, the RM prefix, inactive nav items. Reads on `background` and `card` at 4.5:1 or better. Modern light on `muted` is 4.4:1 (code value, kept): avoid small text on `muted` there.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of ghost and outline buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, the Void entry button, money-out amounts (always with a leading − sign as well).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Pixel direction: the 2px hard border.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 1px offset, on every control. Modern light keeps the code value `#a8a29e` (2.5:1 on `card`): raise to `#78716c` if the ring must meet 3:1; the other directions meet it.

tokens.name: envelope-1
tokens.usage: Envelope slot 1 (Food in the sample data). Swatch, chip ring, progress fill. Modern keeps the exact code value `#E07A5F` (2.9:1 on light `card`); envelope colours identify, they never carry meaning alone, so every swatch sits next to its name.

tokens.name: envelope-2
tokens.usage: Envelope slot 2. Modern light `#F2CC8F` is 1.5:1 on `card`: kept exact from code, so the swatch is always paired with the envelope name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: envelope-3
tokens.usage: Envelope slot 3.

tokens.name: envelope-4
tokens.usage: Envelope slot 4 (Bills). Modern dark keeps `#3D405B` from code, 1.6:1 on `card`: the swatch carries a name, the progress bar sits on `border`.

tokens.name: envelope-5
tokens.usage: Envelope slot 5.

tokens.name: envelope-6
tokens.usage: Envelope slot 6.

tokens.name: envelope-7
tokens.usage: Envelope slot 7 (Fun).

tokens.name: envelope-8
tokens.usage: Envelope slot 8 (Transport).

tokens.name: envelope-none
tokens.usage: An envelope with no colour chosen: a neutral grey swatch.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: Total remaining on the Dashboard and the envelope balance on Envelope detail. Tabular figures. The largest thing on its screen.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Summary card secondary amounts, the money field while typing, Allocate footer. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Row amounts in envelope lists and Activity. Tabular figures, never truncated.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Track the money you have, one envelope at a time.
styles.usage: Body copy, inputs, row labels, buttons. Never smaller than this in a form field.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Labels, captions, helper text, badges, chip balances. In `muted-foreground` unless it is an error.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Day headings in Activity and the bottom-nav labels. The floor: nothing in the app is smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, swatch to name.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between tap targets; chip gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap, sheet padding on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tappable control.

tokens.name: fab-size
tokens.usage: The + in the bottom bar.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon sidebar on tablet.

tokens.name: sidebar-full
tokens.usage: Labelled sidebar on desktop.

tokens.name: content-reading
tokens.usage: Max width of forms, sheets and prose.

tokens.name: content-data
tokens.usage: Max width of the dashboard grid and Activity table.

tokens.name: auth-card
tokens.usage: Max width of the sign-in, sign-up and password cards.

tokens.name: email-width
tokens.usage: The report email table width.

radius.note: Derived from `radius` as the code does: sm 0.6×, md 0.8×, lg 1×, xl 1.4×, 2xl 1.8×. Pixel direction sets every radius to 0; Premium uses 0.375rem base; Retro 0.25rem.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The one base radius.

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chips, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Inputs, the money field.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Swatches, progress bars, the + button, colour radio buttons.
